questions.stem: What must happen to the DNA before a cell can undergo mitosis?

options.text: The DNA must be broken down into amino acids
The DNA must be replicated so each daughter cell receives a full copy
The DNA must be removed from the nucleus
Half the DNA must be destroyed

questions.explanation: Before mitosis, during interphase, all the DNA in the cell is replicated. This ensures that when the cell divides, each daughter cell receives a complete and identical set of chromosomes.
